acceptance: For both detectors: a test that reproduces the silent no-op (no posted status / publish skipped after a green gate / zero shards or cells) and asserts failure, and a positive test asserting it stays green in the normal case

Detector (1) proven before merge by `gh workflow run oracle-verdict.yml --ref <branch-with-a-secret-mapping-removed> -f pr=<canary>` (and the same for oracle-gate.yml): the caller job is red; the same dispatch from the batch integration head on 3 canary PRs (trivial, known-defect, docs-only) is green and posts a status; run links recorded here
Detector (2) would have failed run 41949185392 attempt 2 (show the evaluated condition against that run's job results)
No detector can be bypassed by a skipped upstream job (explicit result checks, not implicit success())
context: Member of batch release-v2-remediation. oracle-verdict and oracle-gate run on pull_request_target, so edits to their callers only run after merge unless dispatched with --ref; use dispatch for all pre-merge evidence. If a detector belongs in Theseus (joeharris76/theseus), change it there via its own PR, then bump the pin per rv2r-07. GUARDRAILS: detectors only add failure conditions; they never relax or skip an existing check; a false red blocks every merge, so canary first. DECISION GATE: any change needing repository or environment settings (secrets, rulesets, required checks) goes to the owner.
description: Two outages were silent no-ops reported as green: after #3942 the oracle-verdict caller ran without secrets, posted nothing, and its jobs still went green; after #3947 the release run concluded success with publish skipped. Add fail-closed detectors: (1) the BenchBox oracle-verdict and oracle-gate callers end with a job that fails when no verdict or gate status was posted for the head (or the Theseus workflow exposes an output that the caller asserts); (2) release-v2 fails the run when publish did not run after a green gate on a tag target, and fails release-uat when zero shard directories or zero executed cells were found. (Detector 3, trunk UAT with zero cells, is owned by rv2r-02.) Each detector has a negative test proving it turns red. Rollback: revert the detector commit; G12 applies (the canary runs below are its calibration).
